The Premium Ryzen page prices RYZEN 512 MB at USD 24 a year with 1 fair-share core at 3.5 GHz+, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, 1 IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6 and 500 GB at 1 Gbit, which is the same shape the tracker lists at USD 17.99 a year.
